about: Home import markers (Q15; philosophy audit #10/#11, N1): data, not kernel code. `apps`: home paths a known app uses (this installation's apps; edit freely). `tools`: home paths a capability (tool) keeps its state in. `personal`: paths whose contents are a personal login (prefix match on the home-relative path); an import skips them unless asked for. Read by core homes/importMarkers.ts from AURA_HOME_IMPORT_MARKERS, /os/home-import/markers.json or /workspace/os/home-import/markers.json.
